accessibility.fullDescription: The boxes directly in front of the extinguisher cabinet represent obstructed access. The rolling bin is an authored decoy and is safe as depicted because it is stable and separated from the cabinet. Exact source applicability and correction language require content-editor approval before scored use.
accessibility.neutralAttemptDescription: A generic hallway with a wall-mounted extinguisher cabinet, two closed boxes on the floor directly in front of it, and a lidded rolling bin farther right.
